articles.title: Musk launches steering-wheel-free taxi service in bet riders lose ‘no control’ fears and hop inside
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Elon Musk sent dozens of self-driving Cybercabs without steering wheels or brake pedals onto the streets of Austin, Texas, on Thursday, betting that Americans will overcome their fears of rides with “no control” and hop inside.

articles.title: Video shows 2 workers escaping moving scaffold during thunderstorm
articles.summary: Dramatic video captures two workers escaping a moving scaffold on a building in Toronto's Yorkville neighbourhood during Wednesday's storm

articles.title: Man charged in connection to fatal Scarborough car crash in May: police
articles.summary: Toronto police have arrested and charged a 39-year-old man from Pickering, Ont. in connection to a fatal Scarborough car crash in May that killed one person and put three others in hospital.

articles.title: ‘Thank God we don’t have the media’: Ford’s off-the-cuff remark raises questions
articles.summary: An off-the-cuff remark by the premier is raising questions about public accountability. articles.title: Complaints about drug use, violence persist at Barbara Hall Park as Toronto considers its response
articles.summary: A Toronto city task force meant to address ongoing issues at Barbara Hall Park is expected to revisit its approach amid ongoing complaints about public drug use and violence in the area.

articles.title: 74-year-old man charged with child abduction in Caledon: police
articles.summary: A 74-year-old man has been charged after an attempted abduction of a child last Saturday evening in Caledon, Ontario Provincial Police say.

articles.title: Pickering teen hospitalized with life-altering injuries after e-scooter crash
articles.summary: A 16-year-old boy is in hospital with life-altering injuries after his electric scooter collided with a vehicle in Pickering Tuesday night.
